mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_transport_order ( order_num, source_system, source_order_no, warehouse_code, carrier_code, state, transport_route_code, dispatch_logistics_node_code, estimated_loading_time, estimated_arrival_time, vehicle_dispatch_time, handover_logistics_node_code, delivery_time, receipt_time, license_plate, id_number, dispatcher, dispatch_time, confirm, dispatch_version, reject_reason, last_reported_vso_state, description, create_time, create_by, modify_time, modify_by, row_version, row_valid ) VALUES ( #{orderNum}, #{sourceSystem}, #{sourceOrderNo}, #{warehouseCode}, #{carrierCode}, #{state}, #{transportRouteCode}, #{dispatchLogisticsNodeCode}, #{estimatedLoadingTime}, #{estimatedArrivalTime}, #{vehicleDispatchTime}, #{handoverLogisticsNodeCode}, #{deliveryTime}, #{receiptTime}, #{licensePlate}, #{idNumber}, #{dispatcher}, #{dispatchTime}, #{confirm}, #{dispatchVersion}, #{rejectReason}, #{lastReportedVsoState}, #{description}, now(), #{createBy}, now(), #{modifyBy}, 1, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_transport_order t SET t.source_system = #{sourceSystem}, t.source_order_no = #{sourceOrderNo}, t.warehouse_code = #{warehouseCode}, t.carrier_code = #{carrierCode}, t.state = #{state}, t.transport_route_code = #{transportRouteCode}, t.dispatch_logistics_node_code = #{dispatchLogisticsNodeCode}, t.estimated_loading_time = #{estimatedLoadingTime}, t.estimated_arrival_time = #{estimatedArrivalTime}, t.vehicle_dispatch_time = #{vehicleDispatchTime}, t.handover_logistics_node_code = #{handoverLogisticsNodeCode}, t.delivery_time = #{deliveryTime}, t.receipt_time = #{receiptTime}, t.license_plate = #{licensePlate}, t.id_number = #{idNumber}, t.dispatcher = #{dispatcher}, t.dispatch_time = #{dispatchTime}, t.confirm = #{confirm}, t.dispatch_version = #{dispatchVersion}, t.reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, t.last_reported_vso_state = #{lastReportedVsoState}, t.description = #{description}, t.modify_time = now(), t.modify_by = #{modifyBy}, t.row_version = t.row_version + 1 WHERE t.id = #{id} AND t.row_valid = 1
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_transport_order t WHERE t.row_valid = 1 AND t.order_num = #{orderNum}
